subject: Data Engineering
title: CI/CD for Data Pipelines
description: A fast breakdown of CI/CD for Data Pipelines for builders.

hook.text: A data engineer pushes a SQL change to production. It breaks three dashboards. There was no staging environment.

buildup.text: CI/CD for data means testing, validating, and deploying pipeline changes through automated workflows.

discovery.text: Pull request checks can run data tests, validate schemas, and preview transformation changes before merge.

twist.text: Data CI/CD is harder than app CI/CD. You need test data, and production data behavior is hard to simulate.

climax.text: Teams with data CI/CD ship faster with fewer incidents because every change is validated before deployment.

punchline.text: Test in staging. Deploy with confidence.

quiz.question: Why is CI/CD harder for data pipelines than for applications?
options: Production data behavior is hard to simulate in test environments
Data pipelines don't use version control
